verdict: Organic presence is holding, but no paid channels are generating leads.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at zero spend, meaning no leads were generated through paid channels. Your Google Business Profile activity across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision combined for 395 total actions — directions, web clicks, and calls — confirming that local search demand exists and is reaching your profiles. That said, GBP engagement is trending down at two of the three locations, and organic search clicks at O'Hare Precision also declined week-over-week, so the organic signals are softening rather than growing. Paid campaigns are being brought back online to capture the demand your profiles are already attracting and to establish trackable leads for the next period.
